{"decision": "pass", "reason": "页面说明了一个 git hook 在提交前要求完成俯卧撑的机制，但核心思路是习惯叠加的常见健身提醒/打卡玩法，缺少超出常规的技术约束或独特洞见；页面大量是营销内容和排行榜，没有实现细节或独立验证。"}

verdict.reasoning: The reason names the git hook that blocks commits until pushups are done, the habit-stacking framing, and the marketing and leaderboard content, all of which appear on the page. Saying the page gives no implementation details is fair, since it only offers an agent setup prompt. The criticism that the idea is a common fitness reminder supports the pass decision.
